sourceNote: Adapted from Alliance DAO accelerator's published ideas. Cherry-picks chain-agnostic themes that fit Sui. Drops EVM-specific themes.

ideas.title: Bot-resistant airdrop infrastructure
ideas.summary: Airdrop tooling that filters bots via zkLogin identity plus on-chain behavior heuristics.
ideas.fitForSui: zkLogin gives a humanity signal without doxxing. Capabilities scope the eligibility checks.
ideas.marketSignal: Airdrop sybil attacks are a recurring industry theme; existing tools are EVM-centric.

ideas.title: Cross-chain yield routing into Sui
ideas.summary: Bridge USDC from EVM and Solana, deposit into Sui money markets, return yield to the user's home chain.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui yield rates often exceed EVM majors; routing tooling does not exist for retail users.
ideas.marketSignal: Cross-chain yield aggregators (Stargate, Across) prove the route demand.

ideas.title: DAO treasury management with multisig and on-chain payroll
ideas.summary: Multisig-controlled DAO treasury that schedules payroll, vesting, and grants via Sui objects.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui multisig is supported natively; vesting state lives in objects with capability access.
ideas.marketSignal: Squads on Solana clears billions in volume; no Sui-native equivalent at maturity.

ideas.title: Mobile-first DeFi consumer app
ideas.summary: DeFi product designed for mobile from the first byte. zkLogin sign-in, sponsored gas, native push notifications.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui Mobile SDK plus zkLogin plus sponsored gas is the most mobile-friendly stack on any L1.
ideas.marketSignal: Crypto mobile penetration is low; consumer DeFi has had no mobile-native breakout.

ideas.title: Gasless onboarding kit for non-crypto apps
ideas.summary: Drop-in SDK that adds Sui-backed receipts and tokens to any consumer app, with zero crypto UX.
ideas.fitForSui: zkLogin plus sponsored tx is purpose-built for gasless onboarding. EVM equivalents need account abstraction plumbing.
ideas.marketSignal: Web2 product onboarding to crypto is a recurring theme; existing SDKs are heavy.

ideas.title: On-chain affiliate and referral rails
ideas.summary: Verifiable referral attribution and payout via Sui capability objects. Marketers cannot under-pay, partners cannot inflate.
ideas.fitForSui: Capability objects model attribution cleanly; sponsored tx hides crypto from affiliates.
ideas.marketSignal: Affiliate fraud is a documented loss vector for ecommerce; verifiable rails are a known ask.
